sources.title: Watco Manufacturing - Trip Lever Bath Waste installation instructions (official manufacturer PDF)
sources.used_for: Parts of a trip-lever waste-and-overflow (overflow plate, linkage, drop cylinder/plunger, overflow elbow, drain elbow) and the fact that the assembly is installed through/behind the tub - i.e., full replacement needs access to the tub side and underside.

sources.title: Watco Manufacturing - Trip Lever installation instructions, variations sheet (official manufacturer PDF)
sources.used_for: Trip-lever linkage adjustment (Quick Adjust / Slip Lock / Turnstyle).

sources.title: Hunker - How To Fix A Bathtub Drain Stopper (trip-lever section)
sources.used_for: Standard from-above procedure: remove the two overflow-plate screws and withdraw the linkage and plunger through the overflow opening; trip-lever plunger types hide all working parts inside the overflow pipe.

sources.title: Plumbing Sniper - How to Fix a Sticky/Broken Trip-Lever Bathtub Stopper
sources.used_for: Cause of sticking: mineral/calcium deposits and gunk on the plunger inside the overflow pipe.
